message.title: Multiconsult - third quarter 2026 results
message.body:
Multiconsult (OSE: MULTI) will release its third quarter 2026 results on Tuesday
3 November at 08:30 CET.

The third quarter report and presentation will be made available on:

https://www.multiconsultgroup.com/investor-relations/

and

https://newsweb.oslobors.no/

For further information, please contact:

Investor relations:
     Pål-Sverre Jørgensen, Group Treasurer & IRO
     Phone: +47 416 11 161
     E-mail: pal.sverre.jorgensen@multiconsultgroup.com / ir@multiconsult.no

Media:
     Lars Nermoen, Communications Director
     Phone: +47 902 40 153
     Email: lars.nermoen@multiconsult.no

This information is subject of the disclosure requirements pursuant to section 5
-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
